mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 59 degrees.

City officials announced that chip seal road treatments begin Wednesday, September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park, so expect some lane closures between 9 AM and 3 PM. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development projects for their October 5 meeting.

There is a lot going on this weekend, starting with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival today and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow or catch trivia nights at various local breweries starting Tuesday.
Reflecting on recent reports, officers handled a variety of incidents, including an unusual call on September 5 involving a social media prank where vehicles were found covered in cheese slices.
While Culver's is currently closed, they will be opening today at 10 AM, and we are looking forward to serving up today's flavor of the day once they open their doors for the morning.
